canonClaims.claim: Lumos produces illumination at the caster's wand tip; Nox extinguishes that magical light.
The fact file supports a lighting function, not automatic spell knowledge, a generic mana pool, or a source-specified cooldown.
Reparo can mend certain damaged objects; mending the physical exterior of a broken wand does not by itself restore its damaged magic.
The dossier supplies no numerical casting cost or duration for Reparo.

startAssumptions: P1 ORIGINAL PREMISE: a magically eligible adult learner owns an intact wand and has already learned Lumos and Nox.
P1 ORIGINAL PREMISE: an ordinary nonmagical adult visitor owns a wand but has no magical source or learned casting method.
P1 ORIGINAL PREMISE: learner is in a dim storage room and can leave freely; no enemy, teacher, reward, debt, or mandatory quest exists.
P1 ORIGINAL PREMISE: Reparo is a later separate learned method, not granted by this starting premise; wand ownership alone cannot silently grant the missing source.
stateAndReaders: Actor: {wandOwnership:bool, magicalSource:bool, learnedSpells:Set<SpellId>, location:RoomId}. Casting gated by magicalSource AND learnedSpells, NOT wandOwnership alone.
LightState: {on:bool, casterId:ActorId, wandId:WandId, worldScope:RoomId}. Scoped to actor/wand/world; no global or unscoped illumination.
WandObject: {physicalIntegrity:enum, magicalIntegrity:enum}. H2 separates these: Reparo may alter physicalIntegrity but cannot restore magicalIntegrity.
No reader or JSON label confers casting ability; the schema is an inert proposal, not registered game data. No mana, cooldown, or cost field is source-specified.

actions.name: Lumos (learner)
actions.preconditions: magicalSource=true AND 'Lumos' in learnedSpells AND wand present AND wand.magicalIntegrity intact.
actions.effect: Set LightState.on=true scoped to caster/wand/room. No item, money, or new mastery awarded.
actions.sourceVsDesign: H1 supports the lighting function; the toggle loop and scoping are O1 design proposals, not source-specified mechanics.

actions.name: Nox (learner)
actions.preconditions: LightState.on=true AND casterId matches current actor AND same wandId.
actions.effect: Set LightState.on=false. No mutation beyond extinguishing the scoped light.
actions.sourceVsDesign: H1 supports extinguishing; the explicit toggle action and its preconditions are O1 design proposals.

actions.name: Visitor attempts Lumos
actions.preconditions: wandOwnership=true BUT magicalSource=false AND 'Lumos' not in learnedSpells.
actions.effect: REFUSE: no light, no mutation, no new mastery, no item. Attempt is inert; wand ownership does not grant casting.
actions.sourceVsDesign: P1 premise enforces refusal; the refusal path is an O1 design guard, not a source-specified spell failure.

actions.name: Leave room
actions.preconditions: None; learner may leave freely per P1. No quest, debt, or lockout.
actions.effect: Actor exits room. Accepted LightState and identity persist under later approved save policy; no new source or gameplay installed.
actions.sourceVsDesign: P1 grants free departure; persistence under save policy is an O1 design proposal, not a source claim.

missingConsumers: Wand/source eligibility reader: the 14-field authored_site adapter has no field for magicalSource or learnedSpells set.
Actor/wand/world-scoped LightState consumer: adapter handles scalar input/output, not multi-actor scoped state.
Visibility consumer: no reader consumes LightState.on to alter room illumination for other actors.
WandObject dual-integrity reader (physical vs magical per H2): adapter cannot represent or gate on magicalIntegrity.
Reparo consumer that mutates physicalIntegrity only while leaving magicalIntegrity unchanged; no such code exists.

counterexamples: Visitor with wandOwnership=true casts Lumos: must REFUSE; wand ownership is not a casting source (P1, H1).
Reparo applied to a broken wand restores its magicalIntegrity: violates H2; only physical exterior is mended.
A JSON label 'Lumos' or generated schema field is treated as making the effect playable: the schema is an inert proposal, not registered game data.
A failed or unavailable attempt awards mastery, items, money, or quest completion: violates the no-mutation / no-award rule of O1.
futureWitness: ON: learner with magicalSource and learned Lumos casts; LightState.on=true scoped to that caster/wand/room.
OFF: same learner casts Nox; LightState.on=false; no residual light, no mutation beyond the toggle.
NO-SOURCE REFUSAL: nonmagical visitor with wand attempts Lumos; system refuses, no light, no mastery, no item granted.
LEAVING: learner exits the dim storage room freely; no quest or lockout blocks departure.
PERSISTENCE: accepted LightState and actor identity survive under a later approved save policy; no new gameplay installed by this test.
REPARO LIMIT: a future Reparo action mends wand physicalIntegrity only; magicalIntegrity remains broken per H2; no numerical cost is asserted.
numericalPolicy: No source-specified mana, cooldown, duration, or numerical cost exists in H1 or H2. Any such numbers are O1 design proposals only. No invented citations. Schema is inert; it does not register game law
